newsitem.title: USA: US local phone group files to block FCC rules.
newsitem.headline: US local phone group files to block FCC rules.

text.p: The United States Telephone Association said Monday it has filed suit in a U.S. Appeals Court here to block the Federal Communication Commission's recent rules to open the local phone market to competition.

The group joins the seven regional Baby Bell phone companies, state regulators and other local phone carriers that have filed suit to overturn the rules. The USTA represents the Baby Bells and local phone providers.
The companies and regulators have complained that the FCC -- while implementing the provisions of the 1996 telecommunications law -- has overstepped the authority granted to it by Congress.
The USTA said it asked the court for a speedy decision "to forestall irreparable economic harm" to local phone companies, "including severe consequences for small and mid-sized companies."
